title: FedFinancesParams
description: Parameters for the Fed balance-sheet income model. SPEC-FED-1.

portfolio_half_life_months.description: EWMA half-life in months for portfolio_yield convergence toward long_rate.

initial_balance_sheet.description: Default SOMA size (normalized) when absent from state.

initial_portfolio_yield.description: Default book yield of the portfolio when absent from state.

initial_deferred_asset.description: Default deferred-asset balance when absent from state.

initial_operating_budget.description: Default operating budget when absent from state.
